MEASURED on `php -n` 8.5.6, with the handle open and four bytes written through it, against the URI
`stream_get_meta_data()` reports:

    file_exists(uri)   php true   elephc false
    is_file(uri)       php true   elephc false
    filesize(uri)      php 4      elephc false
    fopen(uri, 'r')    php reads back "seed"    elephc "Failed to open stream"

php keeps the temp file LINKED until the stream closes and unlinks it then. elephc unlinked it the
moment `mkstemp` returned — the right trick for the anonymous scratc
